$comment: Rules for scripts/build-classes.mjs. Consume effects come from monpet.txt (consumestat/consumecalc); sksrc('Consume'.clc2) is the consumer's Consume Effect bonus.

intro: {consume} sacrifices one of your demons for a timed buff. Every demon gives the bonus below; on top of that, each kind of demon adds its own bonus, listed by section.
Bind a monster with {bind} (it must be below half Life), then consume it. Values scale with {consume}'s level and with +% Consume Effect from items.
With any of the three elite Warlock books (Ars Dul'Mephistos, Ars Al'Diabolos, Ars Tor'Baalos), Consume lasts permanently and is kept when you leave the game.
You can consume any creature up to level 110.

sections.title: Monsters
sections.intro: Regular monsters, and their champion and unique versions. Monsters with the same bonus are listed together.

sections.title: Super Uniques
sections.intro: Named unique monsters such as Bishibosh and Rakanishu.

sections.title: Bosses
sections.intro: Act bosses. The Prime Evils can only be bound while you have the matching book.

sections.title: Your Summons
sections.intro: Demons you summon yourself can be consumed too.

statText.$comment: Rewording for a consume stat. text (or string, a string key) replaces the item wording; with: other stats of the same demon folded into the line, values {2} {3}; x/y/z: calc templates (default {1} {2} {3}); hide drops the stat. Poison is in 256ths per frame and lengths are in frames (25 per second), as on items.

manadrainmaxdam.$comment: the game only shows the min (leech %)

arsdulmephistosaura.text: 5% chance for your kills to get a 10000% Magic Find bonus

arsaldiaboloseffect.text: Fire spells get a fixed 2 second cooldown; Hellfire Lance deals triple damage and fires 3 lances; Flame Wave deals triple damage with double the width

arstorbaaloseffect.text: You can no longer summon demons, but can bind twice as many monsters as your demon limit

calcText.$comment: Mephisto: Player Stats calc1/calc2 are your max Life/Mana (256ths); /1250 per frame is 2% a second
calcText.text: Regenerates 2% of maximum Life per second
Regenerates 2% of maximum Mana per second
